card.name: Words before organization or program names
card.fires_on: Small words like the, a, our, executive or various that come right before the name of an organization, program or partner group in nonprofit or advocacy text. It also fires on the comma after a person's name before their organizational title.

modes.label: Title before organization
modes.description: The word executive, or a comma, after a spokesperson's name and before 'director of' an advocacy group.
modes.example: says Wenonah Hauter,<< executive>> director of Food and Water Watch.

modes.label: Linking word before an organization
modes.description: The, a, our or new right before a program, partner or organization is named.
modes.example: contact<< the>> lead community organization to receive a free Audio

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like initiative, partners and partnership as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a group, program or partnership is about to be named in advocacy or community text.
